reason: I already order through an agent app based in Erbil and it has worked fine for me, so I have no reason to switch to a new name I don't know. Most of what I buy is small stuff like cables, cases and car accessories, and with 13,000 per kilo plus the minimum fee and delivery, the fees end up bigger than the item.
objection: The per-kilo shipping and the 3,000 minimum make small cheap items not worth it, and I don't know if a new company will still be around if my order goes missing.
would_change_my_mind: A clearly lower total than my current service on a small 200-300 gram order, shown side by side, plus a friend who used them and got the package on time.
